svg.text: U7: 2.5 V shunt reference, 0.2% initial accuracy.
Powered from VM so the clamp works after USB removal.
4.7 kΩ bias ≈2 mA at 12 V; also sets motor current limit.
U8: VM-powered dual open-collector comparator, 2–36 V.
A: hysteretic shunt, nominal ON 13.43 V / OFF ≈12.95 V.
B: NTC overtemperature directly inhibits the driver.
Thresholds and pulse-energy capacity require prototype verification.
R70–R77: 8 × 200 Ω / 2 W in parallel = 25 Ω, ±5%; ≈7.84 W total at 14 V.
Initial supervised-test envelope: ≤0.5 J/event, ≤1 W average; these are qualification targets.
R78: 10 kΩ NTC B25/50=3380 K. Hardware trip around 70°C; firmware trips earlier.
No continuous externally driven load. Safe reversal coast time must be measured.
